title: Traceable Multi-Agent System for Knowledge-Based Forecasting

claim.summary: TraceMAS turns document-supported hypotheses into versioned causal-loop diagrams linked to data, features and forecast models for traceable enterprise forecasting.

modules.name: Versioned CLD-to-data-to-forecast lineage
modules.scope_reason: The shared artifact links document factors to proxies, lagged features and model revisions for forecasting.

modules.name: Temporal availability and source consistency review
modules.scope_reason: Risk checks include timestamp alignment, units, missing sources and data availability; these checks extend beyond forecast-model design.
evidence_locators: PDF p.3; passage beginning "The Risk Reviewer checks"
